senses.gloss: uvaṭaka (EI 1), probably, a verandah, porch or vestibule; cf. Marāṭhī oṭī.
uvacca-vari (SITI), Tamil; tax payable by or for the maintenance of the uvaccar (drummers in temple service).
uvacca-kkāṇi (SITI), Tamil; rent-free land given to the uvaccan̤ for serving as drummer in a temple.
